summary: Build foundational MDQMS knowledge with ISO 13485 Foundation training from a PECB authorized training partner. Prepare for the PECB exam.
audienceIntro: ISO 13485 Foundation training is intended for people involved in medical-device quality management or seeking knowledge of MDQMS processes. It also suits professionals considering work in this field.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. To apply for the PECB Certificate Holder in ISO 13485 Foundation credential, you must pass the PECB ISO 13485 Foundation exam and sign the PECB Code of Ethics; PECB lists no professional-experience or audit/assessment-experience requirement for this designation.
